peergrade_reviews.feedback: I liked the overall concept and idea of the game. However, it feels like it is very complex and hard to play. It's not a very intuitive game, specially if you are not from the Computer Security area. The verbs are very specific and there is not a big vocabulary to play with. I tried a lot of different verbs that should/could have worked and I just kept being stuck. The setting is ok, not that special but does its job. I feel like I tried playing without searching for the answers in the post but couldn't even enter the first door. It's impossible to play it without previous and clear instructions about what to do in every case scenario. I think the main points to improve are the vocabulary and the way that the game describes the situation. I don't think a game should only have Software Engineers specialized in CyberSecurity as the target audience. I tried giving my honest and complete idea as a Game Developer and Designer because I do feel like the game can be a lot of fun and intersting but some parts are too confusing and hard. Don't take it personally, obviously it's just my opinion. Good concept, bad execution.
